action.text: Task: Add regression tests for port access on urlsplit/urlparse results. Implementation (parse.py:177-185): port property checks isdigit()+isascii(), raises ValueError('Port could not be cast to integer value as {port!r}') for non-digit/non-ASCII, then checks 0<=port<=65535, raises ValueError('Port out of range 0-65535'). Error occurs at .port access, not construction. Cases: None→None, ''→cast error, 0→0, 65535→65535, 65536→range error, -1→cast error (minus not digit), abc→cast error, \u0966→cast error (not ASCII). Bytes: same logic, repr shows b'...'. Candidate: 2921cbc8. Test sha: c8f4d478. Doc file: need to read. Next: patch test file, then doc.
